div.div: هُوَ مَبْلُوغٌ بِهِ [He is caused to reach, attain, arrive at, or come to, his appointed end, or term of life, (أَجَلَهُ, or the like, being understood,)] is said of the object of the phrase بَلَغَ ٱللّٰهُ بِهِ [which see, and the phrase next following it]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
